defs.def: a professional cook, especially the most senior cook in a restaurant, hotel, etc. 厨师；（尤指餐馆、旅馆等的）主厨，厨师长

ex.s: It also serves a variety of chef’s specials, beef with rice cakes, and more.
ex.t: 它还供应各种主厨特色菜、年糕炒牛肉等。

ex.s: This nice Cantonese restaurant in Columbia Heights quickly became a destination for chef Henji Cheung’s Hong Kong-style cooking and co-owner Sarah Thompson’s natural wine list that earned her a Michelin nod.
ex.t: 这家位于Columbia Heights的精致粤菜馆，很快成为主厨Henji Cheung的港式料理以及联合老板Sarah Thompson获得米其林认可的天然葡萄酒单的打卡地。

ex.s: Things like kale ribs, fish collars, rejected sweet potatoes, and cucumber butts were all re-appropriated and, with the help of a number of good chefs, turned into excellent cuisine.
ex.t: 像羽衣甘蓝梗、鱼颈肉、被挑拣出的红薯和黄瓜屁股这类东西，都被重新利用，并在几位好厨师的帮助下，变成了极好的菜肴。

ex.s: It is criticized by top chefs.
ex.t: 它受到顶级厨师的批评。

ex.s: Head Chef David Thompson, who received a Michelin star for his Loodon-based Thai restaurant of the same name, opened this branch in the Metropolitan Hotel in 2010.
ex.t: 主厨大卫·汤普森曾凭借其位于伦敦的同名泰国餐厅获得米其林一星，他于2010年在大都会酒店开设了这家分店。

ex.s: Issaya Siamese Club is intematoionally known Thai chef lan Kittichai’s first flagship Bangkok restaurant.
ex.t: Issaya Siamese Club是国际知名的泰国厨师伊恩·基蒂猜在曼谷开设的第一家旗舰餐厅。

ex.s: The best table in this two-story colonial Thai home offers a window right into the kitchen, where you can see chef Gaggan and his staff in action.
ex.t: 这座两层殖民风格泰式宅邸里最好的桌子有一扇正对厨房的窗，你可以看到加甘主厨及其团队工作的情形。

ex.s: They have top-class chefs.
ex.t: 它们拥有顶级厨师。

ex.s: Even though Britain has a reputation for less-than-impressive cuisine, it is producing more top class chefs who appear frequently on our television screens and whose recipe books frequently top the best seller lists.
ex.t: 尽管英国以平庸的烹饪闻名，但它正在培养出更多一流厨师，他们频繁出现在电视屏幕上，其食谱书也经常登上畅销榜榜首。

ex.s: It’s thanks to these TV chefs rather than any advertising campaign that Britons are turning away from meat-and-two-veg and ready-made meals and becoming more adventurous in their cooking habits.
ex.t: 多亏了这些电视厨师而不是任何广告宣传活动，英国人正在远离“一肉两菜”和即食餐，在烹饪习惯上变得更具冒险精神。

ex.s: One in four adults say that TV chefs have made them much more confident about expanding their cookery knowledge and skills, and young people are also getting more interested in cooking.
ex.t: 四分之一的成年人说，电视上的厨师让他们对拓展自己的烹饪知识和技能更有信心，年轻人也对烹饪越来越感兴趣。

ex.s: With an increasing number of male chefs on TV, it’s no longer “uncool” for boys to like cooking.
ex.t: 随着电视上出现越来越多的男性厨师，男孩喜欢烹饪不再是“不酷”的事。

ex.s: Male chefs on TV programmes.
ex.t: 电视节目中的男性厨师。

ex.s: It’s a good sign for the chef if you make a mess around your plate
ex.t: 如果你把盘子周围弄得一团糟，对厨师来说是好兆头

ex.s: In Save Money: Good Food, she visits a different home each week and with the help of chef Matt Tebbutt offers top tips on how to reduce food waste, while preparing recipes for under £5 per family a day.
ex.t: 在《省钱：美味食物》中，她每周走访一户不同的家庭，并在厨师马特·特巴特的帮助下，提供减少食物浪费的顶级建议，同时准备每天每户不到5英镑的食谱。

ex.s: Making yourself a Perfect Chef
ex.t: 让自己成为完美大厨

ex.s: Does a chef’s hat make the resultant food taste better?
ex.t: 厨师的帽子会让做出来的食物更好吃吗？

ex.s: Mike 49 Chef (1 picture) With five children, we’re one big family!
ex.t: Mike 49厨师（ 1张照片）我们是一个大家庭，有五个孩子！

ex.s: Like a lot of chefs I know, I don’t really do much cooking at home.
ex.t: 和我认识的很多厨师一样，我不太在家做饭。

ex.s: We toasted each other, we laughed, and the simple, homemade dishes tasted more delicious than anything cooked by a top chef.
ex.t: 我们互相敬酒，大笑起来，简单的自制菜肴比顶级厨师烹饪的任何菜肴都更美味。

ex.s: Until a few years ago was a chef, and a happy one at that, but I wanted more out of life.
ex.t: 直到几年前，我还是一名厨师，而且是一名快乐的厨师，但我想要更多的生活。

ex.s: Shared a delicious meal with some other backpackers at Chef Cui’s restaurant.
ex.t: 在Chef Cui的餐厅与其他背包客共进美味佳肴。
